verdict.rationale: Okta documents SCIM-based user and group provisioning with a schema and RESTful CRUD API, which covers the downstream half of the story: changes reaching app assignments. Event hooks offer outbound automation on org events. Nothing in the pack shows an HRIS acting as the source of truth or joiner/mover/leaver events flowing in automatically. Missing for 10: HRIS-as-source-of-truth inbound provisioning, documented joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle automation, automatic deprovisioning on termination, independent or hands-on corroboration.
